    Your legs

    The legs show up here once you have two stops.

    Each leg is checked from a full tank, as if you fill up at every stop. If you don’t, add the miles of the legs between fill-ups yourself.

    Miles are approximate. On the plates, a purple F marks gas (legend, page 5), and page 16 lists the long stretches between stations. Gas stations in the atlas: OpenStreetMap as of November 20, 2026, and Overture Maps, November 2026. Check before you go.
